gap:logistic_hyperparams.statement: Determine optimal L2 regularization strength and feature engineering strategies for logistic regression on unlabeled dataset, and identify robust sparse/quantized model configurations.

hyp:l2_regularization_helps.statement: L2 regularization (lambda > 0) reduces Brier score compared to unregularized model (lambda=0) via 5-fold cross-validation.

hyp:interaction_features_help.statement: Interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) reduce Brier score; paired t-test across folds will show t-statistic > 2.0.

hyp:sparse_quantized_config.statement: Sparse and quantized logistic models maintain competitive Brier performance; optimal configuration balances sparsity (20-60%) and bit-width (4-8).

claim:l2_regularization_validates.statement: L2 regularization with lambda=0.1 minimizes 5-fold CV Brier score (0.202072) with 35.98% improvement over unregularized baseline (0.315619). Hypothesis hyp:l2_regularization_helps is validated.

claim:interaction_features_weak_effect.statement: Interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) reduce mean Brier score from 0.202072 to 0.175014 (mean difference=0.027058), but paired t-statistic=1.977 is below significance threshold (2.0), p=0.119. interaction_helps=False. Hypothesis hyp:interaction_features_help is not validated.

claim:sparse_quantized_robust.statement: Sparse (20-60%) and quantized (4-8 bit) logistic models maintain or improve Brier score relative to dense baseline (0.140981). Best compressed config is sparsity=20%+bits=4 with Brier=0.141221 (1.001x dense performance). Hypothesis hyp:sparse_quantized_config is validated.

receipt:experiment_complete.statement: Task T3 seed 0 completed: (1) best_lambda=0.1, improvement_over_baseline=0.359761; (2) paired_t_stat=1.977386, interaction_helps=False; (3) best_config=sparsity=20%_bits=4. All three experimental blocks executed with measured outputs saved to answers.json.
